settings.P2_init: mean context of the 64 fresh P1 supports of the fitted law
settings.P2_loss: BCE (clamped 1e-6) on the performed action's 3 horizons, no cummin in training
settings.P3_details: fresh Adam on decoder only (from current weights), no gradient clipping; minibatch = one fresh 32-record batch with context from its preceding fresh batch; batch order reshuffled each epoch with a trial_seed-derived RNG
settings.scoring: ideal_observer_load.endpoint_targets / locked_score (cummin forecasts, saved panels, saved supports, replicate-averaged)
settings.E_definition: mean all-case brier of the result.json curve entries for Base A (block-end, support = learner.history, i.e. the last Base A batch) in cycles 2-8; cycle 8 alone and all 8 cycles reported as sensitivity
settings.control_rule_reading: |Brier(c*_B on Base B) - S_B| <= .02 for every seed

summary.verdict_rule_reading: control checked per seed, two-sided |diff| <= .02 (coded before the full run)
